Government of Bangladesh: The Government of Bangladesh, specifically the Ministry of Finance, acts as the issuing authority for this customs notification.
Ministry of Finance: The Ministry of Finance serves as the parent government department responsible for issuing regulatory notifications related to customs and value added tax matters.
Internal Resources Division: The Internal Resources Division under the Ministry of Finance is the specific administrative body responsible for the publication and enactment of this customs notification.

Customs Act 1969: Section 19(1) of the Customs Act provides the government with the authority to issue notifications to grant exemptions or make modifications to existing customs regimes.
Poultry Farming Equipment: This notification amends previous regulatory orders to expand the scope of duty concessions for poultry farming equipment to include items used for cattle or dairy farming. The legal definitions and operational conditions for these concessions are updated to reflect the inclusion of cattle and dairy operations.
S.R.O. 160-AIN/2012: This notification modifies the existing S.R.O. 160-AIN/2012 by replacing the previous list of eligible poultry equipment with an expanded table of goods that now includes items for cattle and dairy farming. It also replaces restrictive language in the original conditions to broaden the beneficiary scope to include cattle and dairy farm operators.
Bangladesh Customs Tariff: The table of goods eligible for import concessions under this SRO includes various items classified by HS Code, spanning materials such as laboratory supplies, medical kits, plastic structures, metal hardware, machinery, and electronic control systems.
